2.12.15
Image.Width
The Image.Width element specifies the width of an Image. This element is optional. If this element
is present, its value MUST be an RdlSize. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as the
width of the image's container, such as Rectangle or Body minus the value of the Image.Left
element, if specified.
Following is the parent element of the Image.Width element.
Parent elements
Image
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Image.Width element.
 <xsd:element name="Width" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
